bulad tusa bataan izaw ku tulu demiad. cunli u cunli nu Saudi Arab ayza sa ci Mohammed bin Salman , micakat a demiad sa i 2017 a mihcaan 6 bulad 21 demiad. likisi Saudi Arab kalingatuwan i cacay a malebud pitu a lasubu lima a bataan (1750) a mihcaan Arab pan-daw nu teban a niyaduan, nu Muhan-mude. pen .sauti a kuowan atu Ese-lan misumaday a tademaw ci Muhan-mude. a-putula- waha-pu mapulung palekal tu baluhay a kawaw. nikudan satu nu cacay a lasubu lima a bataan (150), Saudi Arab nu lumaan sawni kapah sawni laecus, mangalay miyala tu pankiw a subalan mikuwan sisa caay pisengal atu Egypt kunuheni. 1932年9月22日, . cacay a malebud siwaw a lasubu tulu a bataan idaw ku tusa (1932) a mihcaan siwa a bulad tusa a bataan idaw ku tusa a demiad Saudi Arab mihaneng mihapu tu malecad tu kitasa. 1938年3月3 . cacay a malebud siwaw a lasubu tulu a bataan idaw ku walu (1938) a mihcaan itini i Saudi Arab isasa nu lala makaadih tu simal hidasatu masumad ku cence nuheni. cen-ce Saudi Arab u cen-ciw malecad a cuncu nu saudiihay a kanatal. u aydaay nu miliwanay tu cuncu atekak nu kawaw nu kanatal a adidiay a kuowan idaw henay ku sapikuwanay tu kawaw a kanatal, cacay a malebud siwaw a lasubu siwaw a bataan idaw ku tusa (1992) a mihcaan mlingatu sikawaw tu "ahican ku kanatal a midayumsa " palucekan, Saudi Arab naw ci Apu-tule- aci-ce a laylay nu utiihay mikuwanay tu kanatal, u "Kulan cin " u satalakaway nu sian-fa . . kanatal sakamusa Saliyafa a kawaw. Saudi Arab mahiya nu lihalay a lalumaan u "sacaaya ka lihalaya" a kanatal sa. Saudi Arab a kanatal nu labu inay ku matatungusay a centan, katukuh ayda tusa a malebut idaw ku lima (2005) a mihcaan kinacacay henay amisikiw, misingkiwa sa u tatama acacay ku tanengay misingkiw. nakamusa, kuowan a sapikuwan malalit nu Iselamciw-fa atu duma nu Saudi a laylay nu nipikuwan. anu idaw ku tabakiay nu sapidateng a kawaw sa kuowan amitatengil henay tu duma a nudu Wanse a tademaw, kiwkay nu sakakaay ci Wulima atu nudumaan nu Saudi usiidaay kangadahan nu tademaw. Sunni-pay iluc a Waha-pipay a kanatala nu nipabeli a tapang nu sasadimelay nu kawaw. . nina Ise-lanciw pay silahci itini i kanatal patideng tu cincen-se' atu islanciw a cacudadan pasayda i kanatal micuduh tu nuudip a cacudadan. katukuh ayda, Saudi Arab mahini tu caay kahida nu aydaay a kanatal nu matatungusa a naike, satalakaway atu sapisingkiwan a kawaw. aaidangan a kawaw Saudi Arab idaw ku ahebalay nu likelikenan, langdaw nu buyu' atu bayubayuwan, matatungusay a lalangaw atu likisi nu nababalaki, ilabu nu kanatal han idaw ku lima a kitakit nu liwan namaka babalakiay, nika micidekay nu caay ka lawlaw nu balucu a Muselin kanatal , nu sakay taydaay nu midangay a tademaw nuni ka sasakamuen hiyan tu nu Pawsupay atu sakakaay amipenec. mangalay miales tu nipiida' tu simal, pasayda i sakaudip nu yadahay a sasacelakan, Saudi Arab yadah kunipi patahekal tu kalisiw sapisumad tu nipatideng tu kakitidaan atu misanga tu baluhay a aaidangan. tusa a malebud cacay a bataan idaw ku siwaw a mihcaan siwa a bulad tusa a bataan idaw ku pitu a demiad, Saudi Arab mihapu sa patahkal tu aaidangan, sayaway malingatu patahekal tu sasaliwkuan a cudad sipabeli i sepatay a bataan idaw ku siwa a kanatalan. . nudamaay a kanatal nu tatayna taneng a sacacay sa tayni midang, acaay kasi tanayuay nu lumeniay a dikuc, nika u taydaay amidang nu tademaw kanca a kapah kuni kasidikucan atu kasikadi ku itidaay a tademaw nunikacaay kan tu pah. Saudi Arab kiwkay hulic anipatideng nuitidaay a tademaw awu Muselin . a walu a bataan idaw ku lima (85) - siwa a bataan a kilac (90%) u Saudi a tademaw u Cennipay , u Seyapay muselin a tademaw han i cacay a bataan (10)- cacay a bataan idaw ku lima (15%) a kilac. talakaway a tademaw atu mikuwanay tu kawaw a Sunni pay Muselin itini i Saudi Arab sananay a ngangan a Waha-piciwpay , nu aydaay a Islanciw nu malumanay a cuipay, itini i caca a bataan idaw ku walu a se-ci Arabia subal nu Muhanmuode.epen.apudule-wawhapi nipatideng, hiyahan musakamu nu Islam nuudip a kawaw "cinciw-tuse , "caay pisulul" "atu "sakadimel". pacukeday a tademaw hidasa u sakapahen ku kawaw, duma nunipsa baluhay atu sakakawawen pasaicuwaay hakiya mibatad tu pitu a seci Islamkiw a tademaw Muhanmuode atu masakaputay nuheni a nicudadan. nu caaya kahacica a Seyapay misaayaw tu kakakuliyan atu kiwkay anipi sawacu. . Saudi Arab u cenciw kapulungan nu kanatal. Islamkiw tada micidekay nu Pawsupay Wahapipay u tada kiwkay sa, Saudi Arab sakay nutawan a kawaw itini i kitakit patahkal tu ngiha' nu Wawhapi a singku nu kasaetiman.
